map.基于 TextRank 算法在浏览器本地对句子构图(相似度连边)，按重要性排序抽: Locally build a sentence graph with TextRank (similarity as edges) and extract key sentences by importance as the summary.
map.纯前端运行，文本不上传，适合长文速览与隐私场景。: Runs client-side with no upload, suited to quick long-doc skimming and privacy scenarios.
map.抽取式摘要保留原文句子，忠于原意但可能缺乏连贯；如需改写式需云端大模型。: Extractive summarization keeps original sentences, faithful but possibly less coherent; abstractive rewriting needs a cloud LLM.
map.输入一篇 10 段新闻，工具按句间相似度构图，选出得分最高的 3 句作为摘要。若: Input a 10-paragraph news article; the tool builds the sentence graph by inter-sentence similarity and picks the top-3 scoring sentences as the summary. A core sentence like 'company revenue grew 30%' gets high weight and is retained.
map.TextRank 和云端大模型摘要有何区别？: How does TextRank differ from a cloud LLM summary?
map.TextRank 是本地抽取式，只挑原文句子、不动写、零上传、零成本；大模型可生: TextRank is local and extractive: it only picks original sentences, zero upload, zero cost; an LLM can rewrite more fluently but needs network and compute and sends data out.
map.摘要太短或太长怎么调？: How to adjust if the summary is too short or too long?
